law.payments.title: Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan on Payments and Payment Systems, article 25-1, paragraph 3-1
law.payments.suspend: The organisation suspends the instruction or blocks the amount “for at most five working days”.
law.payments.ask: It analyses its client's operations, “including obtaining additional information from the client” needed to clarify the circumstances and decide.
law.payments.block: If the client does not give the requested information in time, the account is blocked “until the client explains”.
law.centre.title: Rules of the Anti-Fraud Centre (resolution No. 54 of the Board of the National Bank of 25 August 2025), paragraph 24
law.centre.grounds: After a fraud report the receiver's bank pauses the crediting and finds out on what grounds the receiver gets the money.

start.title: The bank asks both sides
start.lead: The bank's anti-fraud has stopped a transfer between two clients. The app asks the receiver and the sender separately and compares their answers.
start.how.1: The receiver is asked first: who sent the money and what for. The sender's message is hidden.
start.how.2: Then the sender is asked the same. Neither sees the other's answer.
start.how.3: Answers in Kazakh and Russian are compared. If they match and the bank facts are calm, the money is credited at once.
start.how.4: Otherwise a bank specialist decides with a ready case file.
start.phones.text: Open them on two phones or in two windows.
start.phones.online: Open them in two windows of this browser.
start.staff.online: No password needed: this is your own practice board. Other visitors do not see it, and after two hours it starts again.
start.matcher.gemini_note: Both answers go to Google's Gemini, without numbers, amounts and account data. If the model does not answer within 20 seconds, the offline word list compares.
start.matcher.offline.no_key: GEMINI_API_KEY is not set, so the language model is off.
start.matcher.offline.no_package: There is a key, but the package google-genai is not installed.
start.matcher.offline.client_error: The Gemini client could not be created.
start.model.checking: Checking the model on Google's list…
start.model.confirmed: The model is on Google's list.
start.model.replaced: The chosen model is not on Google's list; another Flash model is used.
start.model.unconfirmed: Google's model list is not reachable; the model is not confirmed.
start.honest: The offline word list reads words, not sentences. If a gang coaches both people with the same story, the comparison alone is not enough: bank facts, the repeated-story check and a person must stay.
